description: Generic PR/bot patterns — engineering delivery, not Paginate catalogue debt

patterns.title: NULL country branches excluded from Country filter
patterns.detection: country IN (@Country) without COALESCE(country, N'(blank)') in prm_Country / branches CTE
patterns.fix_hint: COALESCE(country, N'(blank)') in parameter dataset and branch list SQL

patterns.title: TablixColumn count vs TablixColumnHierarchy members
patterns.detection: TablixColumn count != empty TablixMember count in column hierarchy
patterns.fix_hint: Add one TablixMember per column; adjust tablix and page width

patterns.title: Branch picker not filtered by Country
patterns.detection: Branches/Clubs parameter dataset SQL lacks @Country when product expects cascade
patterns.fix_hint: Scope branch list SQL with IN (@Country) using same COALESCE sentinel

patterns.title: Bot review older than PR head commit
Paginated export not manually verified
patterns.fix_hint: Run PDF/Excel in PBRS; confirm filters and first column

patterns.title: Circuit inline finding with Consequence: None (no code change)
patterns.detection: abc-circuit body contains 'Consequence: None' or title starts with 'None:' and describes matching normalization
patterns.fix_hint: Reply on thread acknowledging parity; resolve thread. Do not rewrite SQL unless QA shows empty filter results.

patterns.title: Circuit PR check failed but only informational findings
patterns.detection: Circuit PR review check conclusion failure with 1 finding and Low Risk summary
patterns.fix_hint: Treat as process green for merge after human reply; chase approvers not new commits.

patterns.title: Payment Method / Charge Type param list vs MainQuery COALESCE
patterns.detection: Revenue Sales .rdl adds prm_PaymentMethod/prm_ChargeType with Not specified sentinel
patterns.fix_hint: Before PR: confirm same COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(...)) in param dataset and MainQuery WHERE; if aligned, pre-empt Circuit reply text.
